name: Miniscore
subtitle: Basketball box scores
promotionalText: Compare both teams at a glance. Explore player stats, quarter scores and saved games in a compact basketball box score.
description:
Basketball box scores, without the clutter.

Miniscore puts both teams together in a compact view, so you can compare final scores and player statistics at a glance.

• Browse and search published games by team or date.
• Compare points, rebounds, assists, field goals made and attempted.
• See minutes played, starters and substitutes ordered by playing time.
• Tap a player for their full name, steals, blocks and turnovers.
• Expand the score for venue and quarter totals.
• Pull to refresh, or reopen the app to check for updates.
• Revisit saved games offline after a successful refresh.
• Use light or dark appearance and larger text sizes.

No Miniscore account is required. New game data appears when published; availability and update times may vary. Miniscore does not provide live play-by-play coverage.

Support: s.ivica@gmail.com
reviewNotes: No sign-in is required. Open the menu to select a published game. Tap a player for additional stats or the Final arrow for venue and quarter scores. Pull down to refresh. The app caches validated game data for offline use; first launch also includes a dated bundled snapshot. Game data is published daily rather than live play-by-play.
